subject: Superintendent 2019–2020 Performance Evaluation
overview: The Medford School Committee met to review Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent's 2019–2020 self-evaluation. The committee approved a formal timeline for members to submit written evaluations for compilation and referred future evaluation procedures to subcommittee.

items.title: Superintendent 2019–2020 Goals and Performance Evaluation Review
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented her self-evaluation for the 2019–2020 school year, after which the committee approved a motion setting a February 8 deadline for members to submit rubric feedback, scheduling a public review for February 22, and referring standing evaluation procedures to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee.
